articles.summary: Marathon Petroleum Corp. (NYSE: MPC) today announced that David E. Constable has been elected to the company's board of directors, effective March 1, 2027. "We are fortunate to have David joining as a member of our Board of Directors," said Marathon Chairman, President and CEO Maryann Mannen. "He will bring over four decades of global leadership experience in the energy, chemicals, engineering and construction sectors, a tremendous asset as we execute our strategy." Most recently Constable served as Chairman and CEO of Fluor Corporation, the culmination of a career that spans the engineering, construction and energy industries. As CEO, Constable also led global chemical and energy company Sasol Ltd. from 2011 to 2016, followed by three years as a senior advisor to Cerberus Capital Management LP. He is a member of the board of ABB Ltd and previously served on the boards of Anadarko Petroleum and Rio Tinto. "We're pleased to welcome David to the Marathon Board," said Marathon Lead
articles.title: David Constable to join Marathon Petroleum Corporation Board of Directors

articles.summary: The board of directors of Marathon Petroleum Corp. (NYSE: MPC) has declared a dividend of $1.10 per share on common stock, an increase of 10% over its previous dividend of $1.00 per share. The dividend is payable Dec. 10, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business Nov. 18, 2026. About Marathon Petroleum Corporation Marathon Petroleum Corporation (MPC) is a leading, integrated, downstream and midstream energy company headquartered in Findlay, Ohio. The company operates the nation's largest refining system. MPC's marketing system includes branded locations across the United States, including Marathon brand retail outlets. MPC also owns the general partner and majority limited partner interest in MPLX LP, a midstream company that owns and operates gathering, processing, and fractionation assets, as well as crude oil and light product transportation and logistics infrastructure. More information is available at www.marathonpetroleum.com . Investor Relations Contacts:
